products.name: SV(slx)
products.shortDescription: Premium 24V DC Solenoid Valve (SV) for RO Water Purifiers- 100% Copper Coil
products.longDescription:
The 24V DC Solenoid Valve (SV) is an essential component for domestic RO water purifiers. It automatically regulates water feed, cutting off supply when the storage tank is full or during power cuts to prevent overflow, pump dry-run, and membrane fouling.

Key Features:
• 100% Copper Coil: Ensures longer operational life and minimal heat generation.
• Automatic Flow Control: Instant shut-off prevents continuous water bypass and wastewater drainage.
• Universal Fit: Compatible with all standard domestic RO, UV, and UF water purifiers.
• Leak-Proof Construction: Durable food-grade POM body with a tight inner seal.

Technical Specifications:
• Operating Voltage: 24V DC
• Pressure Range: 0.02 – 0.8 MPa (0 – 120 PSI)
• Port Size / Fitting: 1/4" (6.35 mm) Standard Push-Fit
• Body Material: Food-Grade Engineering Plastic & Brass
• Duty Cycle: 100% Continuous ED
